summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
summary_short.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…

summary_short.zh: Understand-Anything 能将任意代码库转化为交互式知识图谱，让开发者可以直观地探索、搜索并提问代码逻辑。其核心创新在于利用图结构表示代码组件间的关联，将复杂系统变得可导航。你可以将其与 Claude Code、Copilot 等 AI 编程助手集成，即时可视化项目架构并自然语言查询，从而加速新手上手和调试过程。
summary_short.en: Understand-Anything transforms any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph, enabling developers to explore, search, and ask questions about their code. Its key insight is using graph-based representations to capture relationships between code components, making complex syst…

summary_short.zh: s-ui 是一款专为 SagerNet/Sing-Box 代理设计的进阶网页面板，旨在简化 Hysteria、Shadowsocks、VLESS 等多协议代理的配置与管理。其核心优势在于通过统一直观界面，将复杂设置流程化，降低手动配置错误率。技术亮点包括原生多协议支持、实时流量监控及灵活规则调整。部署于服务器后，可集中管理节点、监控网络状态并动态调整策略，适合个人或小团队搭建稳定易维护的代理基础设施，无需频繁修改配置文件即可快速切换协议或更新规则，提升运维效率。
summary_short.en: s-ui is an advanced web panel designed for managing SagerNet/Sing-Box proxies, simplifying the configuration of multi-protocol proxies like Hysteria, Shadowsocks, and VLESS. Its key strength lies in providing a unified, intuitive interface for complex proxy setups, reducing manu…
summary_short.es: s-ui is an advanced web panel designed for managing SagerNet/Sing-Box proxies, simplifying the configuration of multi-protocol proxies like Hysteria, Shadowsocks, and VLESS. Its key strength lies in providing a unified, intuitive interface for complex proxy setups, reducing manu…

summary_short.zh: Skills 是一个面向 .NET 和 C# 开发的 AI 编码代理技能库，通过可复用模块化技能增强代理实用性。其核心将代码生成、测试、调试等常见任务封装为独立技能，支持按需组合调用，实现复杂工作流自动化。技术上强调组合性，开发者可像搭积木般自由搭配技能，定制专属开发助手。实际应用中，集成至 AI 代理后，可快速实现 .NET 项目脚手架搭建、单元测试自动生成或代码审查，是提升 AI 辅助 .NET 开发效率的开箱即用工具集。
summary_short.en: Skills is a repository of reusable, modular capabilities that enhance AI coding agents for .NET and C# development. It provides pre-built skills like code generation, testing, and debugging, enabling agents to perform complex tasks reliably. The project emphasizes composability,…
summary_short.es: Skills is a repository of reusable, modular capabilities that enhance AI coding agents for .NET and C# development. It provides pre-built skills like code generation, testing, and debugging, enabling agents to perform complex tasks reliably. The project emphasizes composability,…

summary_short.zh: Agency-agents是一个开源框架，旨在简化多智能体AI系统的构建。它通过提供预配置的专用智能体，解决协调多样化AI能力的复杂性。每个智能体具有独特的个性和处理流程，支持模块化协作，适用于前端开发、内容审核等特定任务。开发者可通过API快速部署智能体，定制现有智能体以适应新领域，或组合它们构建复杂工作流。该框架适用于自动化多步骤、多专业知识项目，鼓励用户创建智能体团队解决实际问题。
summary_short.en: Agency-agents is an open-source framework that simplifies building multi-agent AI systems by providing pre-configured specialized agents, addressing the complexity of coordinating diverse AI capabilities. Its key insight is structuring agents with distinct personalities and proc…

summary_short.zh: Forge是一个Python框架，用于构建自托管的多步骤智能体工作流，核心能力是让大语言模型调用工具并执行复杂任务。其技术亮点在于模块化设计：将工具定义、LLM后端（如Ollama、llama.cpp）和工作流逻辑解耦，开发者可灵活组合组件。例如，定义搜索和计算工具后，LLM能自动决定调用顺序。实际应用中，Forge适合构建本地AI助手，用于自动化数据检索、文档处理或代码生成，所有数据本地处理以保障隐私。用户可从单步工具调用逐步扩展为多步骤流程。
summary_short.en: Forge is a Python framework for building self-hosted, multi-step agentic workflows with LLM tool-calling. Its key insight is a modular design that separates tool definitions, LLM backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, etc.), and workflow logic, enabling flexible composition. Use it to cre…
